messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a targeted recompute run for eu-agg-hours to fix late-event stitching. Window: 2026-03-24 06:00 UTC (11pm PT). Will canary on 5 tenants first. Need quick call on routing/quota + a console UX for tenant owners to opt-in to applied changes.

jonathan: Scope? rows / shards? rough duration?

maya: ~12M hourly rows total, sharded by tenant, expected pipeline runtime ~3h on dedicated throughput. Canary should take ~15–20m.

rachel: For console UX: propose a temporary flag per-tenant: `recompute.mode = preview|apply`. Default `preview`. Also a toast that says "Metrics may change after recompute (click to review diffs)". Small PRD incoming.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: job-4580123456-recompute-eu (owner: maya). ETA: 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z. Status: scheduled.

liam: Routing question — do we push this into Dedicated capacity or run on shared? Dedicated avoids tail impact on production routes. I propose a nightly dedicated lane with quota cap 30% so it can't starve normal traffic.

maya: +1 to dedicated lane. Also need an abort switch and trace tag `recompute.source=playbook` so we can correlate traces/alerts.

jonathan: For quotas: ensure backfill uses a consumer-side backfill_quota that counts separately from realtime quotas. Otherwise customers see throttles.

alex: From product POV, prefer opt-in at tenant level for full apply. Preview mode should still surface deltas to workspace owners and create a changelog entry. Also require an email summary when apply runs.

rachel: I'll draft the PRD and a small UX mock for the toast + modal with before/after delta preview. Will add a console boolean `allow_recompute_apply` on tenant settings.

maya: Quick implementation checklist: 1) schedule job on dedicated lane + quota cap, 2) add `recompute.source` tag & abort endpoint, 3) console flag + preview modal, 4) changelog entry + email summary, 5) canary on 5 tenants then ramp.

jonathan: Example API to apply after review:
```
POST /v1/tenants/:id/recompute?mode=apply
Body: {"job_id":"job-4580123456-recompute-eu", "approver":"alex"}
```

liam: I'll provision the dedicated spot and set a 30% cap for the 06:00–09:00 UTC window.

ops-bot: job-4580123456-recompute-eu status -> queued on dedicated-lane-3.

alex: OK — proceed with canary. rachel please loop in security for the audit/email bits. If security okay, greenlight to run canary tonight.

rachel: pinging @security in #eng-security now, will post the PRD link here when ready.

maya: Thanks — will post a short rollback/runbook in this thread before start. :thumbsup:
